notes.title: Hope River Town Update is Live! 🌵
notes.notes:
[p]Howdy folks,[/p][p]We know you’ve been waiting a long time for this, and today we’re thrilled to finally bring you the [b]biggest content update yet[/b] for [i]Dust & Courage: Jake Bolton’s Journey[/i]![/p][p]This update has taken longer than expected, mainly because we wanted to implement proper gamepad support first (a highly requested feature). It delayed things by over a month, but we believe it was worth the wait, and now the new content is finally ready for you to discover.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="fTbnZpXnBNQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]What’s New in This Update?[/h3][p][/p][p]We’ve added [b]over 1 hour of fresh gameplay content[/b], bringing the total playtime of the Early Access version up to [b]around 3 hours[/b]. Here’s what you’ll find in this update:[/p][list][*][p][b]A New Town: Hope River Town[/b][/p][p] If you remember Hope River from the demo, forget what you saw back then. [b]We’ve overhauled almost everything.[/b] The only thing that remains the same is its name. The new Hope River Town is richer, deeper, and full of new stories waiting to be discovered.[/p][/*][*][p][b]14 New NPCs to Meet[/b] [/p][p] Each with unique personalities and dialogue.[/p][/*][*][p][b]10+ New Quests[/b] [/p][p] Expanding Jake’s journey with brand new challenges and decisions to make.[/p][/*][*][p][b]5 New Weapons[/b] [/p][p] Fresh ways to fight your battles, both up close and at range.[/p][/*][*][p][b]10 New Outfits[/b] [/p][p]Customize Jake’s look and style to your liking.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Why the Delay?[/h3][p]As mentioned, this update was pushed back because we wanted to make sure accessibility features such as [b]gamepad support, WASD movement, and auto-attack[/b] were fully functional before releasing new content. Many of you have requested it, and we understand the importance it holds for immersion and accessibility. We appreciate your patience, it’s finally here, and we hope it makes your experience even smoother.[/p][p][/p][h3]What’s Next?[/h3][p]We’re getting closer to the end of Jake’s story. Most of the Early Access content is now in place, and you’re already seeing more than half of the full game.[/p][p]From here on out, our main focus will be on finishing the story. If everything goes according to plan, we hope to wrap up development in the next [b]4–6 months[/b]. Of course, game development is unpredictable, so no promises, but that’s the goal.[/p][p]At the same time, half of our team has already started working on our second project. It’s still too early to share much, but if you want to catch the first details when the time comes, make sure to follow us on our social media channels. 
[url=https://discord.gg/vtdtWscChE] 
 
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44980757/b9e06642e24be956be4eb56134628a5e52ad2f91.png[/img][/url][h3]Thank You[/h3][p]Your feedback and support mean the world to us. This project is being built with your input at every step, and we couldn’t do it without you. Please keep sharing your thoughts on our [b]Steam Discussion; [/b]we read every single one.[/p][p]So saddle up, head into [b]Hope River Town[/b], and let us know what you think![/p][p]See you on the dusty trail,
The Storyforge Team
[/p]

notes.title: By the Numbers: Your Adventure So Far
notes.notes:
[p]Up until now, our devlogs have been all about [b]what we’ve been making[/b]: new quests, bug fixes, new towns, and new mechanics.
But this time, we’re flipping the script.
This devlog is about [b]you,[/b] the cowboys who’ve been shaping the story with every dusty footstep.[/p][p][/p][p]So saddle up: here’s what you’ve been up to in [b]Dust & Courage: Jake Bolton’s Journey[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980757/912acbd3d46034c9b8c7cbcdea0a8b880ed6e5aa.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]🐥 Billy the Chick?! - [i]19.4%[/i][/h3][p]Only the bravest (or most confused?) [b]19.4%[/b] of you took one look at poor Henrietta the chicken and said:
“Yep. That’s Billy now.”
We’re not judging… but Billy definitely is.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980757/4b00fd8ad69292bee43b7bdcef70124a7b37b48e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]👅 Tongue Twister - [i]18.9%[/i][/h3][p]Strong memory, strong cowboy brain!
Just [b]18.9%[/b] of you nailed the tricky dialogue challenge on the first try.
The rest of you? Don’t worry, tumbleweeds don’t remember either.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980757/c38fc4bfb49684ab72d30c5f0792251792ab41c4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]🐇 Bunny Botherers - [i]57.9%[/i][/h3][p]This one hurt. Really? MORE THAN HALF OF THE PLAYERS?!
[b]57.9% of players[/b] showed no mercy to the poor bunnies, earning [i]“Elmer Fudd Would Be Proud.”[/i]
Somewhere, the Easter Bunny is weeping… and plotting revenge.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980757/1d8ba34044024067661ab9ed158537a79b462e73.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]🌾 Folklore & Fertilizer - [i]33.8%[/i] [/h3][p]The Druids of the Wild West, the Shaman is proud of you: [b]33.8%[/b] of you turned Starshard Farm into more than just a dirt pile.
Green thumbs in a desert? Now [i]that’s[/i] magic.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980757/2e88dfb13c31e7f6dddccd10ed0f5db25c5b85cb.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]🗝️ The Wild West’s Best Kept Secret - [i]31.2%[/i][/h3][p]On the same dusty trail, [b]31.2%[/b] of you also uncovered the hidden cave.
Forget Indiana Jones, the real explorers wear cowboy hats.[/p][p][/p][h2]🌄 The Story So Far…[/h2][p]From renaming Henrietta, to fighting with skeletons to declaring war on innocent cacti, you’ve turned [i]Dust & Courage[/i] into more than a game. You’ve turned it into a living, chaotic cowboy tale.[/p][p]We’ll keep building the world.
You keep surprising us in it.
Deal?[/p][p][/p][p]Stay dusty,
Team Storyforge[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Controller Support
notes.notes:
Howdy!

Since we first launched Dust & Courage: Jake Bolton’s Journey, one question has echoed louder than any other: “When will controller support arrive?”

We wish we could have delivered it from the start, but when we first began development, we designed the entire game around keyboard and mouse. Implementing full controller support now means ripping out the existing input system and rebuilding it from scratch and that would push our 1.0 release back at least two months. For a tiny indie team like ours, a two-month delay could be a death knell.

Every time someone asked about controller support, we’d clash in the dev chat, our programmer even blocked me on Discord for a while in frustration! We have just one programmer in our team, and between polishing the Early Access map “Hope Town” and gearing up for full launch, our days and nights blur together.

Then we got a message that changed everything:

[quote=Issie721;594018898545787837] Same my daughter.  She keeps watching the video lol and says, "Mama...I love this game already, and havent even played it."  She has nerve damage in her right arm and hand from a birth defect.  So she needs gamepad support and auto aim and auto attack in games.  So please Mr. Developer 2....tell Mr. Developer 1.....guy with coffee..... its for a few people who love this game already and are disabled.  Maybe he will feel more empathetic if he hears the truth behind why we ask and why its so important to us.  Offer him a hug maybe too...he needs a friend to encourage him and tell him how great he is.  Have him hop on here and I will tell him myself. [/quote]

Her daughter’s story broke our hearts and she wasn’t alone. Dozens of players reached out asking for more accessible controls.

Suddenly, this wasn’t about deadlines or obstacles. It was about responsibility. A little girl was locked out of our world, and the only barrier was us. That had to change.

So we dropped everything else, rolled up our sleeves, and pulled multiple all-nighters. It was brutal, but we never gave up. And now —drumroll, please— [b]Dust & Courage: Jake Bolton’s Journey offers full controller support with auto-attack! 🎉[/b]

We:
[list]
[*] Rebuilt our input system from the ground up to recognize every major controller.
[*] Recrafted menus and HUD so you can navigate with thumbsticks and d-pads.
[*] Added auto-aim and auto-attack toggles so players of all abilities can enjoy combat.
[/list]

We set out to share our story with everyone, and we believe no one should be left behind.

Thank you for your patience and welcome to the adventure!

With love,
The Storyforge Team

notes.title: Auto Attack and WASD Movement Update!
notes.notes:
Since we released the very first demo of Dust&Courage: Jake Bolton's Journey, we’ve heard three big, recurring requests from you:

[list]
[*] WASD movement
[*] Auto-attack
[*] And of course, gamepad support
[/list]

We’ve been all ears from day one and doing our best to bring these features to life alongside you. After a bit of gentle pressure (and maybe annoying our dev just enough times), one day he finally snapped, in the best way possible. He paused everything and went off to build a whole new system.

The result? You can now move with WASD and enable auto-attack, no more relying solely on the mouse!

To try these new features out, just update to the latest version of the game and head over to the Settings menu. We’ve made sure you can toggle them on or off however you like, so if you prefer the old-school controls, that’s totally cool too.

Now, let’s talk gamepad support.

This one means a lot, not just to you, but to us as well. We’ve always known how important it is for everyone to be able to play the game comfortably, and folks using a Steam Deck. But truth be told, making this happen earlier would’ve pushed our full release back by at least two months.

So… we asked our dev again. And again. And again. We may have been banned from Discord a few times in the process. But then one day, something changed. A message struck a chord, and just like that, he rolled up his sleeves and got to work on full gamepad support.

Yes, really. The “impossible” feature is now in development!

While we’re moving fast, we can’t give an exact release date just yet. But rest assured, it’s coming very soon.

If you’ve read this far… hey there!
Hope you’re having a great week. Thanks so much for all your support, feedback, and patience. We’re beyond grateful ❤️

With love,
The Storyforge Team

notes.title: Early Access Starts Today! - Let's Celebrate Together!
notes.notes:
[h2]What Can You Expect from Early Access?[/h2]

Get ready to dive into Jake Bolton’s thrilling journey! Here's a quick overview of what you can expect in our Early Access release:

[b]Jake’s Story Begins:[/b] The game opens up with the start of Jake’s bold and dangerous adventure. Players will begin to uncover his past and catch glimpses of the bigger story ahead.
[b]Four New Maps:[/b] Explore four new maps that you've never seen before, each offering unique environments and challenges.
[b]Brand New NPCs:[/b] Meet new characters that will add depth to the game’s world and offer exciting new quests and interactions.
[b]New Weapons:[/b] Equip yourself with an array of new weapons to tackle your enemies. Choose strategically to adapt to the challenges you’ll face.
[b]New Quest Trees:[/b] Dive into fresh quests and branching storylines. Each decision will lead to different outcomes and paths in Jake’s journey.

[h2]What’s Coming Next?[/h2]

This is just the beginning! We’re not stopping with Early Access. In the next two months, we’re planning to release a major update that will include:

[b]A New Town[/b]: A new town will be introduced, featuring interactive shops and a large saloon.
[b]New Shops:[/b] You’ll be able to enter shops and purchase different items from various vendors. Each shop will offer its own unique goods and atmosphere.
[b]New Locations, Quests, and Characters:[/b] As always, we’ll be adding more places to explore, new quests to take on, and more characters to meet, expanding the world of Dust & Courage.

[h2]What About the 1.0 Release?[/h2]

We aim for a 6-8 month journey toward the 1.0 release. Throughout this period, your feedback will play a crucial role in shaping the game. Please don’t hesitate to share your thoughts and ideas with us! Your feedback is not only a source of motivation for us but also directly influences the future of the game.

If we see even more enthusiasm and requests from our player base than expected, we might extend the development by a few months, allowing us to add a broader story and finalize the game with a more expansive conclusion.

There’s More to Come!
Don’t worry, this is only the beginning! There’s still so much more to share about Dust & Courage. More updates, new content, and exciting developments are on the way. Stay tuned!

With love,
Team Storyforge

notes.title: Our Demo is Live!
notes.notes:
It's hard to put into words just how excited and grateful we are right now. After nearly a year of pouring our hearts into this project, we can finally share what we’ve been working on. Jake’s Journey holds a very special place in our hearts. It's our dream project, and bringing it to life has truly changed us. We hope you love playing it as much as we’ve loved creating it, and that you have a lot of fun along the way!

This demo is just a small sneak peek of what’s to come in the full game. The story in the demo isn’t fully representative of the final version; it’s a unique build created just for this preview. The final game’s story will take different paths, but you’ll still encounter some familiar faces when the full adventure begins.

As you play the demo, we would love to hear your thoughts. Please leave us a review or comment with your feedback—it will help shape the game and improve the experience. We're listening closely and want to build this game with you, so every piece of feedback is invaluable to us.

notes.title: Major Update: We’ve Redesigned Our Characters!
notes.notes:
Howdy, cowboys!

We are thrilled to bring you our very first devlog, packed with exciting news. Dust&Courage: Jake Bolton's Journey is our first indie game, and it holds a special place in our hearts. Bringing this project to life has been like experiencing the excitement of a new adventure. As a small team of four, we had no idea how massive this project would become, but now we’re on the verge of completing our first demo.

What started as a mere dream has transformed into a fully-fledged game studio, and here we stand, a team of four long-time friends, united by a shared passion. Our 20-year friendship has significantly influenced this project, with some of us even leaving our professional careers to pursue game development full-time. We aim to channel this excitement into creating the best experience for you.

Since our prototype, there have been numerous improvements we've aimed to make. Our primary goal has always been to tell a compelling story. We consider ourselves storytellers first and game developers second, and we want to reflect that in our games. Although we have finished writing the story for our game, there are still many aspects we want to enhance. We started with visual changes. Since launching our Steam page, we’ve updated our character designs to offer you a more unique gaming experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44980757/20eeb256f1559877231db4351ca09353d7e413b8.gif[/img]

In addition to updating our main character, Jake, we have almost completely redesigned our game world. We’ve revamped nearly every area from scratch, and we can’t wait to show them to you. Alongside these changes, we’ve also updated the visuals, text, and layout of our Steam page. We hope you’ll enjoy the new look.

Your feedback is incredibly valuable to us, so please don’t hesitate to share your thoughts. You can reach us through the Steam discussion section or join our Discord channel. Our development team is eager to answer your questions and chat with you.
